newsitem.title: USA: Anadigics ships one million circuit units.
newsitem.headline: Anadigics ships one million circuit units.

text.p: Anadigics Inc on Wednesday said it has shipped over one million gallium arsenide integrated circuits for use in personal communications services, or PCS, telephone handsets.
The handsets are those that support the CDMA (code division multiple access) digital PCS standard.
The firm said its circuits are used in the transmitter of the CDMA telephone handset.
Also, the driver and power amplifier circuits are used in handsets manufactured by QUALCOMM Personal Electronics, a joint venture of subsidiaries of QUALCOMM Inc and Sony Corp's Sony Electronics Inc.
